tables.name: Users
tables.m:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(pMockDataRoot & "/Users.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Headers, {{"UserId", Int64.Type}, {"Segment", type text}, {"SignupDate", type date}}, "en-US")
    , Cohort = Table.AddColumn(Typed, "SignupCohort", each Date.StartOfMonth([SignupDate]), type date)
in
    Cohort

tables.name: Date
tables.m:
let
    Source = Csv.Document(File.Contents(pMockDataRoot & "/Date.csv"), [Delimiter=",", Encoding=65001, QuoteStyle=QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Headers = Table.PromoteHeaders(Source, [PromoteAllScalars=true]),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Headers, {{"Date", type date}, {"Year", Int64.Type}, {"Month", Int64.Type}, {"MonthName", type text}}, "en-US")
    , Months = Table.AddColumn(Typed, "MonthStart", each Date.StartOfMonth([Date]), type date)
in
    Months

measures.name: Revenue
measures.contract: Sum event revenue cents / 100; zero for nonconversion

measures.name: Active Users
measures.contract: Distinct event users in current filter; non-additive

measures.name: Conversion Rate
measures.contract: Converted sessions / eligible sessions; blank if no sessions

measures.name: ARPU
measures.contract: Revenue / distinct active users; blank if no active users

measures.name: Sessions
measures.contract: Eligible event sessions in current filter.

measures.name: Cohort Size
measures.contract: All enrolled users in selected cohort and segment.

measures.name: Eligible Cohort Users
measures.contract: Distinct enrolled users with an observed age cell; excludes future cohort-age combinations.

measures.name: Retained Users
measures.dax: VAR Eligible = [Eligible Cohort Users] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(Eligible), BLANK(), COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(CohortActivity[UserId]), CohortActivity[Active] = 1, REMOVEFILTERS('Date')), 0))
measures.contract: Distinct cohort users active in observed age months; zero if observed but inactive, blank if future.

measures.name: Retention Rate
measures.contract: Distinct retained population / distinct eligible cohort population; totals recompute both sets.

verification: Authoring inputs only; TMDL, DAX, processing and Desktop NOT VERIFIED
